secureHint: Your data is private to your business. Use at least 10 characters for your password.

loginHint: Your business day, all in one place.
productSearchHint: Tap a product to add it to your bill.
keyboardHint: Amounts are calculated by the server when you confirm.

ownerOnly: This slice supports business owners. Staff invitations and roles are planned.
settingsHint: Simple preferences for the way you work.

notFoundHint: Go back to your shop or the homepage.
